name: Concussive Strike (Ex)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Advanced Rogue Talents

Benefit: A rogue with this ability can deal a powerful blow to the head in conjunction with her sneak attack, dealing 1 point of damage to her target’s Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma.
